metas.name: Brothers-in-Law
metas.description: Aliyans (Brothers-in-Law) is a hit Malayalam sitcom on Kaumudy TV, directed by Rajesh Thalachira. It premiered on February 24, 2020, as a sequel to Aliyan vs Aliyan (Brother-in-Law vs Brother-in-Law). Set in Thiruvananthapuram, the show follows Ratnamma and her family, centering on the love-hate dynamic between brothers-in-law Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes revolve around Cleatus landing in trouble thanks to his quirky ideas, with Kanakan often stepping in to save the day.

metas.name: Cousins and Kalyanams
metas.description: A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

metas.name: Patharamattu
metas.description: A mother seeks ideal matches for her three daughters. Two families: wealthy jeweler Ananthamoorthy's clan and modest Udayabhanu and Kanakadurga with their daughters.

metas.name: Pavithram
metas.description: Forced marriage, a clash of tradition and faith, leads to a complex journey of transformation for a woman named Vedha. The series explores themes of resilience, redemption, and the power of love amidst societal pressures

metas.name: Jai Mahendran
metas.description: When Mahendran, a corrupt and manipulative deputy Thasildar, believes in getting things done through powerplay and influence within the system, becomes the victim of his own plans to sabotage an entire system in an attempt to safeguard his job and restore his reputation.

metas.name: Uppum Mulakum
metas.description: The sitcom drama revolves around the family of Balachandran, his wife Neelima, their four kids Vishnu, Lakshmi, Keshav, Shivani and Neelima's Brother Sreekuttan.

metas.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe
metas.description: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?
